correctness.rationale: Proof combines exact coefficient-to-semigroup transitions below 5q, four explicit five-periodic membership stages, invariant splice boundaries under q↦q+5, and four verified bases q=6,7,8,9. All asserted transition increments computed from cyclic period words. The packaged checker confirms 396 semigroup cases plus 22 independently generated cyclotomic polynomials, which corroborate but do not replace proof.
